newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ukraine c. bank cuts refinancing rate to 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine c. bank cuts refinancing rate to 21 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank cut its key refinancing rate to 21 percent from 25 percent with effect from May 26, a central bank spokeswoman said on Monday.
"The National Bank sent all commercial banks a telegram today about a cut in interest rates to 21 percent," she said.
The National Bank last cut the rate, from 40 percent, on March 8. Early last year the rate was 105 percent.

Two weeks ago the cabinet called on the central bank to cut its rate given the recent slowdown in inflation. Prices rose 0.8 percent in April and were up 4.4 percent in the first four months of this year.

Earlier this month Prime Minister Pavel Lazarenko forecast inflation this year would be 15-16 percent, rather than the 25 percent previously forecast by the government and the actual price rise of 39.7 percent in 1996.
